specification.composite_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: S07 riverside gathering scene, DAY complete original composite C for a quiet game.
Input Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its coarse visible gouache strokes, dry-brush edges, colored-pencil contour marks, sparse forms and muted matte palette. Do not reproduce the indoor subject.
Scene: a riverside footpath at the edge of a small town in soft diffuse morning daylight. A simple low stone arch bridge crosses the narrow river in the left background. A broad bare earth footpath curves along the left bank. One clearly structured plain tree trunk rises at the far-left edge with a single readable sage canopy extending across the upper-left. A few simple foreground grass tufts along the left riverbank, one restrained clump of tiny wildflowers, and a small cluster of three pale quartz stones among moss beside the path. Keep these few objects readable and separate.
Composition: 16:9 wide edge-to-edge. River bend, path and bridge occupy the left two thirds; rightmost 30 percent is smooth quiet dusty-teal river surface with only a few broad horizontal brush marks and a low distant bank. Bottom 12 percent mainly plain ground and quiet water, with the few foreground grass tufts near lower-left only. Soft modest sky; no houses in view, people, boats, animals, lamps, ornamental structures or dense foliage clutter. Water is matte paint, not photorealistic reflection.
STYLE_V2: gouache picture-book illustration, visible brush strokes and dry-brush edges, slightly wobbly hand-drawn colored-pencil outlines, simplified shapes, slightly imperfect perspective, limited palette of seven muted colors (cream, warm grey, walnut brown, sage green, dusty teal, faded plum, ochre), soft diffuse daylight, cool-tinted shadows, generous empty wall and floor space interpreted here as generous quiet open bank and water, only a few props, one clear focal point, calm and quiet, matte paper texture, no text, no people.
NEGATIVE: glow, bloom, light rays, god rays, lens flare, bokeh, depth of field blur, gold filigree, ornate carvings, glossy or plastic surfaces, hyper-detailed clutter, photorealism, symmetrical fantasy composition, wisteria everywhere, text, letters, numbers, UI, labels, blank plaques, interface frames, borders.
Requested native 2560×1440 if available, otherwise actual largest native 16:9. Do not draw resolution text.
specification.cleanplate_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: S07 DAY raw cleanplate B_all for true extracted foreground grass and tree-canopy layers.
Input Image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET. Remove ONLY the following:
1. All leaves of the foreground tree canopy across the upper-left/top edge. Keep the main tree trunk and thick bare branch structure in their original positions and fill behind removed leaves with the original painted sky.
2. The foreground grass tufts along the lower-left riverbank and beside the curving path, including the small wildflower stalks that grow among those tufts. Fill behind them with the plausible plain earth path/bank or water immediately behind the specific blades.
Keep the three pale stones and their moss, the static tree trunk/branches, bridge masonry, every riverbank boundary, background distant vegetation, path position and sky/clouds unchanged. IMPORTANT: retain the water itself and its existing painted brush marks; do not erase the river, replace it with land, or invent water waves. Water will later use an exact region mask from this original composite, not a regenerated ripple image.
Keep DAY lighting, color, camera, crop and same native dimensions; preserve unrelated pixels as closely as possible. Maintain the matte gouache medium, visible dry-brush strokes, slightly wobbly colored-pencil outline and muted seven-family palette.
No new objects, people, animals, text, numbers, UI, plaques, borders, glow, bloom, bright sparkles or photorealism.
specification.annotation_notes: Second manual annotation: S01 includes full flower racemes and lower canopy leaves; S07 includes complete foreground flower stalks and excludes grass polygons from the retained-original water mask. No independently redrawn Li.

processing_prompt: 从真实完整合成C按人工硬多边形取得1px羽化软mask；以6px外扩mask保存AI补底授权证据。rawB只通过软mask局部贴回C，保留其余原像素；用C、该软mask和B_i反解Li，不生成或独立重画物件。单层与全部层均按严格ROI阈值检查，重叠、边缘反解裁值和未通过项目如实记录。
cleanplate_method: AI raw B is normalized with equal-aspect cover; final B_i/B_all are a soft-mask patch over actual C. The 6px dilation is retained as AI authorization evidence; undamaged context outside the soft mask is copied from C, never claimed as unchanged AI output.
mask_usage_notice: 本批rawB已先以C作参考生成，内置工具未接收这些显式mask。1px软mask与6px扩区在随后人工标图后生成，用作可审阅的局部合成边界及后续重生目标，不声称已作为本轮生图参数。
